label: official-code numerical-compatibility variant; softmax-underflow gradient bridge

lineage.scientific_configuration_change: replace only non-finite KL target gradients at exact-zero softmax probabilities with the finite composite softmax-KL limit
lineage.restart_policy: restart from epoch zero; the excluded checkpoint is not a valid continuation state
lineage.identity_policy: never label this run as unchanged official training

official_source.source_policy: read and execute in place; do not copy source into ACT and do not modify the official clone

compatibility_variant.finite_regime_policy: native forward values and gradients are unchanged
compatibility_variant.underflow_policy: replace a non-finite incoming gradient only at an exact-zero softmax probability
compatibility_variant.failure_policy: a non-finite gradient at any positive probability or any non-finite checkpoint state terminates the run

environment.construction: Python venv derived from act-py312 with system-site-packages; only missing official imports are installed into the isolated prefix

dataset.name: CIFAR10
dataset.interface: official torchvision CIFAR10 used by the released source

run.source_behavior_note: released train_moe.py constructs and schedules the router optimizer from the main optimizer/lr fields, not the router-specific argument fields
run.checkpoint_selection: released code: best adversarial accuracy; test set participates in released checkpoint selection and is recorded as an artifact limitation

preflight_gates.checkpoint_finiteness: every floating state in model, router, and both optimizers must be finite before snapshot publication

artifact_policy.checkpoint_redistribution: hash and reproduction instructions only pending legal review because the source repository has no license file
